# SD13-E2 deterministic Dwarf Fighter level 1 race-semantics recognition fixture.
# Represents a deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Dwarf Fighter level 1 identity as
# chosen input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. The ability scores already reflect the fixed PF1 Core Dwarf +2
# Constitution / -2 Charisma racial adjustment (recognition-only on the compute
# seam, not arithmetic performed there).
#
# The Fighter chassis, combat baseline, total saves, and selected-skill modifiers
# stay claim-blocked on this input because the bounded GE-06 Fighter compute path
# is grounded only for race:human; that is expected and unrelated to this fixture's
# purpose, which is to make the bounded Dwarf race-semantics recognition legible.
# It deliberately avoids every unproven Dwarf family: no racial bonus feat (PF1
# core Dwarves gain none), no skill or derived-stat modifiers (Stonecunning,
# Appraise), no Defensive Training / Hardy / Stability / Hatred computation, and
# no weapon familiarity grant.
case_id=pf1-crb-dwarf-fighter-level1
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:dwarf
class_level=class:fighter:1
ability=strength:14
ability=dexterity:12

ability=charisma:6
